name: percentile spectrum
domain: 轨道不平顺与信号处理
definition_zh: 按指定累积概率水平获得的不平顺谱。
usage_overview: 用于表征和区分不同累积概率水平下的轨道不平顺激励。它在各波长处选取指定百分位对应的谱密度值组成谱线，使不同概率水平的激励可用相应谱线表示。

complete_examples.text: On this basis, the railway's track geometry status and characteristics of track irregularity spectrum were analyzed, and then formula fitting and parameter extraction were conducted for track irregularity statistical average spectrum using Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm and 7 parameters formula of Chinese trunk railways, last we proposed a method that any percentile spectrum could be transformed by track irregularity statistical average spectrum through which.
